name: Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple
summary: Open 3 am to 11 pm; general darshan is free and Sugam (VIP) Darshan costs ₹300. Aarti times, phone and locker rules for Kashi's main Shiva temple.
description:
Shri Kashi Vishwanath is the temple most visitors to Varanasi plan their trip around. It is dedicated to Lord Shiva as Vishwanath, the lord of the universe, and is one of the twelve jyotirlingas. Since the Kashi Vishwanath Dham corridor was built, the temple connects straight to the Ganga, so you can walk up from the ghats instead of squeezing through the old lanes.

The temple is open from 3 am to 11 pm, with darshan in three windows through the day. Entry is free. If you're short of time on a match day, Sugam Darshan (₹300 per person) gives you a guided, queue-free visit with a Shastri, a box of prasad and locker use. Book it, and any aarti, only on the temple trust's official website or app. Agents outside who promise "special darshan" are not part of the official system.

Leave your phone, camera, bag and even pens in the free lockers before you join the queue; nothing electronic is allowed inside. There's no formal dress code, but modest clothes are expected. If you want the Mangala Aarti at 3 am, report at Gate 1 by 2:30 am.

The stadium at Ganjari is roughly 16 km away in a straight line and further by road, so don't try to fit a peak-hour darshan into the same few hours as a match. Mornings before an evening game, or the day after, work much better.

seoTitle: Kashi Vishwanath temple opening & closing time, VIP darshan

faqs.q: What time does Kashi Vishwanath temple open and close?
faqs.a: The temple opens at 3 am and closes at 11 pm. General darshan runs in three windows: 4–11 am, 12:20–7 pm and 8:30–9 pm, with the aartis held in between. Timings change on festivals and in Shravan, so check the temple trust's official website before a special-day visit.

faqs.q: What is the VIP darshan ticket price at Kashi Vishwanath?
faqs.a: What people call VIP darshan is officially Sugam Darshan, at ₹300 per person. It gives you a queue-free visit with a Shastri, a box of prasad and locker use. Book it only on the temple trust's official website or app. Agents outside who promise "special darshan" are not part of the official system.

faqs.q: Is darshan at Kashi Vishwanath free?
faqs.a: Yes, general darshan is free. You only pay for Sugam Darshan and aarti bookings, and only on the official website or app.

faqs.q: What time is the Mangala Aarti?
faqs.a: Mangala Aarti is from 3 to 4 am. Report at Gate 1 by 2:30 am. Book it only on the temple trust's official website or app.

faqs.q: Is a mobile phone allowed inside Kashi Vishwanath temple?
faqs.a: No. Phones, cameras, any gadgets, bags and even pens aren't allowed inside. Free lockers are available at Mandir Chauk, the helpdesk and the YSK centres; leave your things there before you join the queue.

faqs.q: Is there a dress code at Kashi Vishwanath?
faqs.a: There's no formal dress code, but the temple trust asks visitors to wear decent clothes.
